title: MIRAGE · Sessions
description: Every session on every protocol. Click a session to open it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))

SELECT countIf(auth_success = 1) FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))

SELECT sum(inputs) FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))

SELECT sum(auth_attempts) FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))

SELECT countIf(length(tokens) > 0) FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))

SELECT countIf(length(artifacts) > 0) FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))

panels.title: Recent sessions
panels.description: predicted_class is the actor classifier's prediction, tactics and techniques the tagger's labels (ATT&CK IDs). Empty where a model has said nothing yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.start_ts AS start_ts, s.session_id AS session_id, s.protocol AS protocol, s.src_ip AS src_ip, s.actor_id AS actor_id, ac.cls AS predicted_class, round(ac.cls_confidence, 2) AS class_confidence, tg.tactics AS tactics, tg.techniques AS techniques, s.duration_s AS duration_s, s.inputs AS inputs, s.decisions AS decisions, s.fallbacks AS fallbacks, s.auth_attempts AS auth_attempts, s.logged_in AS logged_in, s.credentials AS credentials, s.client AS client, s.tokens AS tokens, s.artifacts AS artifacts FROM (SELECT start_ts, session_id, protocol, src_ip, actor_id, round(dateDiff('millisecond', start_ts, end_ts) / 1000, 1) AS duration_s, inputs, decisions, fallbacks, auth_attempts, auth_success AS logged_in, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(c -> concat(c.1, ' / ', c.2), credentials), ', ') AS credentials, coalesce(nullIf(JSONExtractString(fingerprints, 'client_version'), ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(fingerprints, 'user_agent'), ''), '') AS client, length(tokens) AS tokens, length(artifacts) AS artifacts FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}')) ORDER BY start_ts DESC LIMIT 500) AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT if(cm.session_id != '', cm.session_id, a.session_id) AS lsid, argMax(a.actor_class, a.ts) AS cls, argMax(a.confidence, a.ts) AS cls_confidence, argMax(a.decided_by, a.ts) AS cls_decided_by FROM (SELECT session_id, actor_class, confidence, decided_by, ts FROM mirage.actor_class FINAL WHERE ts >= $__fromTime) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT conn_id, session_id FROM mirage.session_map FINAL) AS cm ON cm.conn_id = a.session_id GROUP BY lsid) AS ac ON ac.lsid = s.session_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT lsid, arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(tactic)), ', ') AS tactics, arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(technique)), ', ') AS techniques FROM (SELECT DISTINCT if(m.session_id != '', m.session_id, l.session_id) AS lsid, l.tactic AS tactic, l.technique AS technique FROM (SELECT session_id, tactic, technique FROM mirage.labels FINAL WHERE technique != '' AND ts >= $__fromTime) AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT conn_id, session_id FROM mirage.session_map FINAL) AS m ON m.conn_id = l.session_id) GROUP BY lsid) AS tg ON tg.lsid = s.session_id ORDER BY start_ts DESC

panels.title: Predicted actor class
panels.description: The classifier's prediction for the sessions above (mirage.actor_class).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(ac.cls = '', 'not classified', ac.cls) AS actor_class, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT session_id FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))) AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT if(cm.session_id != '', cm.session_id, a.session_id) AS lsid, argMax(a.actor_class, a.ts) AS cls, argMax(a.confidence, a.ts) AS cls_confidence, argMax(a.decided_by, a.ts) AS cls_decided_by FROM (SELECT session_id, actor_class, confidence, decided_by, ts FROM mirage.actor_class FINAL WHERE ts >= $__fromTime) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT conn_id, session_id FROM mirage.session_map FINAL) AS cm ON cm.conn_id = a.session_id GROUP BY lsid) AS ac ON ac.lsid = s.session_id GROUP BY actor_class

panels.title: Tactics found (sessions)
panels.description: Sessions in which the tagger found each ATT&CK tactic (mirage.labels).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.tactic AS tactic, uniqExact(t.lsid) AS sessions FROM (SELECT DISTINCT if(m.session_id != '', m.session_id, l.session_id) AS lsid, l.tactic AS tactic, l.technique AS technique FROM (SELECT session_id, tactic, technique FROM mirage.labels FINAL WHERE technique != '' AND ts >= $__fromTime) AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT conn_id, session_id FROM mirage.session_map FINAL) AS m ON m.conn_id = l.session_id) AS t INNER JOIN (SELECT session_id FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))) AS s ON s.session_id = t.lsid GROUP BY tactic ORDER BY sessions DESC

panels.title: Techniques found (sessions)
panels.description: Sessions in which the tagger found each ATT&CK technique (mirage.labels).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.technique AS technique, uniqExact(t.lsid) AS sessions FROM (SELECT DISTINCT if(m.session_id != '', m.session_id, l.session_id) AS lsid, l.tactic AS tactic, l.technique AS technique FROM (SELECT session_id, tactic, technique FROM mirage.labels FINAL WHERE technique != '' AND ts >= $__fromTime) AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT conn_id, session_id FROM mirage.session_map FINAL) AS m ON m.conn_id = l.session_id) AS t INNER JOIN (SELECT session_id FROM mirage.session_summary FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_ts) AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}'))) AS s ON s.session_id = t.lsid GROUP BY technique ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, class, count() AS events FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source != 'policy' AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}')) GROUP BY time, class ORDER BY time

SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'command') AS command, count() AS times, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source != 'policy' AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}')) AND source = 'cowrie' AND class = 'process_activity' AND action = 'command' AND outcome = 'unknown' GROUP BY command ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'method') AS method, JSONExtractString(payload, 'path') AS path, JSONExtractInt(payload, 'status') AS status, count() AS times FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source != 'policy' AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}')) AND class = 'http_activity' GROUP BY method, path, status ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT protocol, JSONExtractString(payload, 'username') AS username, JSONExtractString(payload, 'password') AS password, count() AS attempts, countIf(outcome = 'success') AS succeeded FROM mirage.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source != 'policy' AND ('${protocol}' = 'all' OR protocol = '${protocol}') AND (match('${src}', '^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{0,45}$') AND ('${src}' = '' OR src_ip = '${src}')) AND class = 'authentication' AND action = 'login' GROUP BY protocol, username, password ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 100
